description: Photographic reconstruction of Al-Talaqi Square, Al Khobar, plus four canopy studies. Fitted pillar crowns, lower braces, circular arm-to-rim ends and roof connections throughout all five options. Recessed bases, corrected planting and strong spiral turns are retained. Fine weave and rib/band crossings remain architectural approximations; concealed fixings are omitted. Visible joints and dimensions are reconstructed, not surveyed or fabrication-ready. Estimated site location: 26.311 N, 50.203 E (WGS 84), a user-authorised road-level approximation; true north and elevation unverified.
